content.text:
**2 medicines — card prices by chain (no place given)**
1. Atorvastatin Calcium — 30 × 10mg Tablet
2. Lisinopril — 30 × 10mg Tablet
All of them at one chain, by the sum of the card prices seen (low to high):
- Walmart (TX price): $23.22 for 2 medicines, prices observed 2026-09-27 to 2026-09-30 (#1 $14.22, #2 $9.00)
- CVS: $75.32 for 2 medicines, prices observed 2026-10-02 (#1 $59.98, #2 $15.34)
A sum adds up observed card prices; it is not a quote.
The card price is set per chain (Walmart: per state), so choose the chain, not the address.
We don't see stock — call the pharmacy before you go.

Next (calls that fit this answer, arguments filled in from it):
- ask for a 5-digit US ZIP, then compare_basket(drugs=["atorvastatin-calcium", "lisinopril"]) — These sums are by chain nationally; with a ZIP only chains with a store nearby are listed.
- get_savings_card() — One card covers every medicine in the list.
- ask which of the matches they mean, then compare_prices() — Other strengths or pack sizes of one of them.

**Free FineRx card:** BIN 610219 · PCN DRX · Group MYCARD3993
Use the free FineRx card — accepted at 34+ pharmacy chains, no signup. Save it, print it, email or text it. Savings with the card can be substantial — estimated prices are on our site. Show the card at the pharmacy to get the final price.
_Not insurance · prices observed 2026-09-20 · FineRx may earn a fee · not medical advice_
